input.summary: Replace Singapore law/venue in 28.1 with New York law, consistent with the New York County venue in 28.2
input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction with New York law, which is our standard position and removes the conflict with the New York County venue already agreed in Section 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the courts of London would also work for us.

ops.oldText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
ops.newText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction.
